rule_1: Read today's challenge and its three objectives.
rule_2: Start the clock, then work each objective, ticking them off as you go.
rule_3: Meet all three before the timer runs out to complete the Gauntlet.
objective_1: File your Position within the first fifteen minutes
objective_2: Defend your Position against at least three direct Challenges
objective_3: Claim the top Archetype rank before the Gauntlet closes
hero_subtitle: One provocation. One clock. A test of whether your take holds up under pressure.
rules_footnote: A self-paced test of conviction - no sign-up, nothing is scored or shared.
reward_description: Awarded to the day's sharpest finisher — unlocks Elite Archetype status and permanent leaderboard placement.
challenge_description: One Provocation. One hour to file, defend, and outlast every opposing Position. The world doesn't wait for a considered opinion — this tests whether yours holds under pressure. Your Archetype is on the line.
